Do you remember what it felt like the first time you reversed out of your own driveway? That feeling was pure freedom. But for your parents? It was probably one of the scariest moments of their lives. When you were a teenager, there was simply no way for your parents to know how fast you were driving, when you'd reached your destination, or whether you were driving safely. No news was good news — hope was the only real tool they had until they got word that you were safe.

If you now have a teenager who's driving, be thankful you don't have to live in the kind of fear of the unknown your parents did. Yes, 2026's technology has plenty of downsides, but HeyPolo is a clear-cut example of how tech is making life better and safer for teenage drivers.

HeyPolo is far more than just a paid version of Apple's "Find My"

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all for one price. The driving component is what sets it apart from basic location-sharing apps (like Apple's Find My). Every single trip your teen driver takes is tracked and scored — you can clearly see the entire journey: how fast they were going, whether they used their phone while driving, whether there were any harsh braking or rapid acceleration events, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

Driving scores rate each trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you don't have to guess whether your son or daughter is really driving safely. You can see the data, have a serious conversation with them if their performance needs work, and as their driving habits improve, so will their scores. Compared to anything available to the previous generation, this is a far more useful way to genuinely help new drivers do better behind the wheel.

Crash detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Add to that the arrival notifications — triggered when your teen reaches school, sports practice, a friend's house, or home — and you shift from "no news is good news" to truly knowing whether they're safe. You don't have to wait for them to text or ring you once they arrive. You'll know exactly when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for a parent. HeyPolo updates location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, the whole family

One HeyPolo subscription covers your entire family — absolutely no extra per-person charges. The people who developed it are the team behind Surfshark, meaning they have robust privacy infrastructure backing them up. They won't sell your data, you decide who you share your location with and when you stop sharing it, and all data is deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, that's a hugely significant privacy safeguard. It works equally well on iPhone and Android, so it doesn't matter if different members of the household have different phone brands.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, so if you try it and decide it's not for you and your family, you're not tied to any contract whatsoever. There's no reason not to give it a go.
